concerns.text: Stale contract contradicts the re-plan. output.schema.yaml still specifies 'p_raw ... adjusted ... using Thomson's MTM' and 'p_holm_bonferroni' with field name 'composition_param', while plan.md Phase 2, research.md, data-model.md, and analysis_schema.schema.yaml all mandate Pyper & Peterman N_eff and plain Bonferroni with 'composition_parameter'/'p_bonferroni'. The plan's Project Structure lists only dataset.schema.yaml and analysis_schema.schema.yaml under contracts/, yet output.schema.yaml exists and could be exercised downstream, reintroducing the un-spec'd Holm/MTM methods the re-plan explicitly reverted. Delete or rewrite this contract to match.

Plan says synced.csv has 'the six required columns plus interpolated_flag' (i.e., 7 columns), while spec US-1's Independent Test says 'exactly five columns' but then lists six names (timestamp, proton_density, temperature, helium_abundance, Kp, Dst). The plan/data-model/contract are internally consistent (7 columns incl. flag); note the spec's own count discrepancy so a verifier doesn't fail the pipeline on the spec's 'five' wording.
